_comment: Channels whose uploads get walked for player cut-ups.
channel_id is preferred: it lets the script derive the uploads playlist
(UC.. -> UU..) and skip a channels.list call. If you only have a handle,
the script resolves it at runtime and prints the id so you can paste it
back here. Handles below are UNVERIFIED placeholders - run the script
once and check the resolution log before trusting them.
Set enabled:false to mute a channel without deleting its config.

channels.name: NFL
channels.notes: Official. Game recaps + some player cut-ups. Best team_game fallback source.
